rules.title: Build before review
rules.text: A task that changed code needs a clean build and passing tests, with the output in build.log, before it moves to review.
rules.why: Review time is wasted on code that does not build.

rules.title: Adversarial review before review
rules.text: A different worker than the author reviews the work with fresh context and writes REVIEW.md before the task moves to review.
rules.why: Authors miss their own mistakes; separation of duties.

rules.title: No push or publish without a decision
rules.text: Pushing, publishing a change request, merging and deleting always need an answered decision card first.

rules.title: Workers report with hc send
rules.text: Every worker handoff ends with the instruction to report with hc send to the orchestrator's address when done or stuck.
rules.why: The orchestrator learns about finished work from reports, not by polling.
